description: This file defines the GDPR controller in an OpenCart project, managing GDPR-related actions such as displaying information, processing GDPR requests, and handling success and error views.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class handling GDPR functionalities such as information display, action processing, and status updates in the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display GDPR information page if available; otherwise redirects to not_found page.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Processes GDPR requests like export or removal based on user input, with validation and response in JSON format.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Handles GDPR success URL, updating status and showing confirmation view based on GDPR action.
